decisions.reason: The firm has publicly backed this modular concept, it fits the announced strategic move toward modular environmental technology, and the cited customer savings give management a strong justification to continue.

As a close extension of the core mobile recycling line and still presented on its own page, this shredder is likely to be retained because management can point to fit with the existing portfolio and ongoing market development.

This modular plant concept has visible customer-reference evidence and quantified savings, so under escalation of commitment management is especially likely to stay with it rather than reverse a public and strategic investment.

Although newer and with less demonstrated market proof so far, it is close to the established shredder business, and a growing firm with R&D capabilities will usually give such a launch more time before withdrawing it.

This screen product supports the firm's broader modular processing direction and was given its own page, so despite limited disclosed results management is likely to persist at least another year rather than admit an early failure.
